Sampler control settings of a fitted mvgam model

Source: R/brms_wrappers.mvgam.R
control_params.mvgam.Rd

The NUTS settings the model was sampled with, such as adapt_delta, max_treedepth and stepsize. A fit that reported divergent transitions can be refitted with a higher adapt_delta, such as update(fit, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)). The sampler then takes smaller steps.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mvgam'
control_params(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted mvgam model.

...

Unused. Anything passed here is refused.

Value

A named list, as brms::control_params() returns for a brmsfit. A fit with no NUTS settings, such as a variational fit, gives an empty list.

See also

mvgam_diagnostics for the divergence counts, summary.mvgam() for convergence checks.

Examples

# \dontrun{
set.seed(1)
simdat <- sim_mvgam(family = poisson(), n_series = 1L,
                    n_timepoints = 60L, trend_model = AR())
mod <- mvgam(y ~ s(x, k = 5), trend_formula = ~ AR(p = 1),
             data = simdat$data_train, family = poisson(),
             chains = 2, seed = 2, silent = 2)
#> Warning: 27 of 2000 (1.0%) transitions ended with a divergence.
#> See https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings for details.
control_params(mod)$adapt_delta
#> [1] 0.8
# }
